**Date:** {{< meta display-date >}}  
**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

My trouble has come; he had a second attack and died at six to-night.
[Mamma](../persons.html#1606) is too like [Amy](../books.html#15), excited with thankfulness. I dread what it will be; I don't think we half believe it yet.

You will write to me; perhaps I may write to-morrow, but I can't tell.

We have [Mr](../persons.html#798). and [Mrs.

Keble](../persons.html#795) helping us to-night.

Oh what will the waking be!

So many of our Psalm superstitions have come true.

Your most affectionate
C. M. Y.
